headline: Sensex snaps losing streak to gain over 300 points, Nifty above 23,200
why: Rebound in metals, FMCG, and defence sectors boosted market sentiment.
Short covering and buying interest ahead of the upcoming US Fed interest rate call.
Positive corporate updates around Tata Sons IPO and semiconductor roadmaps.
whatHappening: Sensex gained over 300 points while Nifty crossed 23,200, snapping a two-day decline.
Shapoorji Pallonji Group welcomed RBI's decision and backed Tata Sons listing.
Jefferies upgraded Navin Fluorine with a target price reflecting 14% upside potential.
Indian quick-commerce players entered a new race to deliver iPhones within minutes.

stocksInNews.sources: Highlighted as a primary beneficiary of potential Tata Sons IPO
Jefferies hiked target price forecasting 14% upside
SP Group supported Tata Sons listing where Tata Motors holds significant stake
Holds major stake in Tata Sons amid updates on IPO listing

summary: Indian equity markets ended higher as Sensex rose over 300 points, led by gains in metals, FMCG, and defence stocks. Optimism around Tata Sons IPO and positive brokerage calls on selective chemical stocks further boosted market sentiment.
